easy_question: Never mind how well it is drawn. Does this picture show a single large cubic gaming die shown in three-quarter view so three faces are visible? A realistic photo, an illustration, a schematic or a clean diagram ALL count as yes. Answer NO only if the image instead shows just a blank card or plain panel that prints an answer with none of that shown, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q_notext: Does this image have any printed NUMBER, digit or numeral written on it (for example a caption stating a count or a measurement)? Answer yes if you can see any printed number, no if there is none. Answer yes or no only.

steps.target: the single large cubic gaming die standing on the pale surface

steps.read_crop: This close-up shows one cubic gaming die resting on a pale surface, tilted so that three of its faces can be seen at once. Look at the die's TOP face -- the face that points up towards the ceiling. Write down every dark round dot drawn on that one face, each with a few plain words saying where on the face it sits. Separate one item from the next with a semicolon; write no running total and nothing else. If that face carries no dot, write the single word NONE.
